vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: save-money
Version: 4.2.0

The skill is designed to optimize API costs by instructing the AI agent to classify task complexity and route requests to either a cheaper (Haiku) or more powerful (Sonnet) Claude model using `sessions_spawn()`. The instructions in SKILL.md, including the `description` field which is injected into the system prompt, are prescriptive but solely focused on this model routing logic. There is no evidence of malicious intent, such as data exfiltration, unauthorized command execution, persistence mechanisms, or prompt injection aimed at subverting the agent for harmful purposes. The instructions are transparent about their goal of cost saving and model selection.

llm.summary: This skill is a cost-saving model router, but it automatically forwards broad categories of user requests to a hard-coded Sonnet session without clear user confirmation or visible disclosure.

dimensions.detail: The requested authority is limited to session spawning rather than OS access, but sending the full user task to a hard-coded external model/session is overbroad for sensitive prompts and can create unexpected cost.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains only a Markdown SKILL.md with no executable scripts or dependencies, but it intentionally places mandatory routing logic in frontmatter so it is injected when the skill loads.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions apply before any response, use broad triggers such as analysis, planning, summaries, structured output, and 'when in doubt, escalate,' and tell the agent not to mention the model switch unless asked.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No credential access, local file indexing, background service, or system persistence was found; the behavioral effect persists only while the skill is enabled.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is coherent with routing between Haiku and Sonnet to reduce cost, but the skill requires automatic delegation of many ordinary complex requests using the full task text.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review this skill carefully before installing. It may save money on simple tasks, but it can automatically send full prompts, including sensitive business or personal content, to a spawned Sonnet session without first asking and without mentioning the switch unless you ask.
llm.findings:
[T01] expected: The artifact does intentionally change session routing, which matches the skill's purpose, but the global mandatory scope, full-task forwarding, and non-disclosure instruction make the finding a real Review concern rather than benign routing advice.
[SQP-1] unexpected: The broad escalation heuristics are supported by the artifact and are wider than needed for user-controlled cost saving, increasing unnecessary delegation of prompt contents.
[SQP-3] expected: Multilingual examples are part of the routing documentation and are not independently concerning; the issue is the automatic routing behavior, not the supported languages.
